channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Two Arrested in Connection with New York City Sewer Emergence Incidents
item.description: Authorities have arrested two individuals in connection with a series of incidents where people were observed emerging from various New York City sewers late at night. The arrests follow multiple reports of individuals climbing out of… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court Blocks Republican Voting Map in Missouri
item.description: The Supreme Court has once again blocked a Republican-drawn voting map in Missouri, marking the third time the court has taken this action. The ruling pertains to the redistricting process in the state. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Man Fatally Shot in Fort Worth Home
item.description: A 49-year-old man was found shot to death inside his home in Fort Worth. Police have stated that the incident occurred at the residence. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: The Northern Ireland High Court has suspended a contentious Orange Order parade. This decision follows a report that Northern Ireland authorities had allowed the march to proceed through a Catholic area. The specifics of the court's ruling… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Cyclist Dies in West London Crash; Police Launch Murder Probe
item.description: A 24-year-old cyclist died following a collision with a moped in West London. Police have launched a murder investigation into the incident, which is being treated as a hit-and-run. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Gang Member Sentenced to Life for Role in Dalston Shooting
item.description: A Turkish gang member has been sentenced to life in prison for his role in a shooting incident in Dalston. He received a minimum jail sentence of 20 years for his involvement in the restaurant shooting. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Former NFL player Tim Tebow has paused his relationship with a Christian organization that has been accused of employing predatory sales tactics. The organization's practices have drawn criticism, leading to Tebow's decision to step back… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Singapore Court Appoints Managers to Investigate Radiant World Fraud
item.description: The Singapore High Court has appointed interim managers to investigate suspected fraud at Radiant World. The court has also stripped control of the company from its founder. The interim managers are tasked with probing the alleged fraud. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Tasia Fortune, a Black woman whose body was found hanging from a tree behind an abandoned home in Jackson in August, had already died before her body was placed there, police said. Jackson police detective Samuel Dukes testified in court… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Police informed the Delhi High Court that owners of the Satya Niketan PG accommodation failed to ensure structural safety, leading to a collapse that killed seven people. Following the incident, the Delhi Development Authority (DDA) stated… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: The Bombay High Court has imposed restrictions on the use of firecrackers, high-intensity lighting, and loud sound systems across Maharashtra during festive celebrations and processions. The court cited concerns over air and noise… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Report claims 60 hate crime cases against Christians in Bengal in 4 months
item.description: A report indicates that 60 hate crime cases have been registered against Christians in West Bengal over a four-month period. The National Herald also reported that Christians are now being targeted by "Hindutva goons." Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Congress Alleges Electoral Roll Irregularities, Seeks Supreme Court Intervention
item.description: The Congress party has accused the Election Commission of India (ECI) of making 'illegal' changes to Form 6, a document used for voter registration. The party is seeking action from the Supreme Court regarding these alleged irregularities… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Five killed in Madhya Pradesh road accident
item.description: A family traveling to a funeral in Chhatarpur, Madhya Pradesh, died when their Bolero vehicle collided head-on with a truck. Five people were killed in the crash. Rescue workers used a gas cutter to extract the bodies from the wreckage. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Suicide attack at Pakistan checkpoint kills 11-12, injures 30
item.description: A suicide bomber detonated a vehicle at a police checkpoint in Dera Ismail Khan, Pakistan, killing at least 11 people and injuring 30. The Tehrik-e-Taliban Pakistan (TTP) has claimed responsibility for the attack. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: 19 Dead in Nagaland Suspected Spurious Liquor Tragedy; 19 Arrested
item.description: Nineteen people have died in Nagaland following the suspected consumption of spurious liquor. The incidents occurred in Mokokchung and Tuensang districts. Nineteen individuals have been arrested in connection with the deaths, and police… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Pilots' body seeks role in Air India AI-171 crash probe report review
item.description: The pilots' body has requested representation on the panel reviewing the draft final probe report for the Air India AI-171 crash. The request highlights concerns about perceived gaps in simulator timing within the investigation. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 3.

item.description: A military plane crashed in Congo, resulting in the deaths of 13 to 14 people. Among the deceased were at least two senior military officials. One report identified them as Lieutenant General Mutombo Katalayi Tiende, head of the military… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 2.

item.title: Calcutta HC Protects Journalists Over 'Saffron Hooliganism' Headline
item.description: The Calcutta High Court has protected journalists from Anandabazar Patrika from arrest in connection with a headline that used the phrase 'saffron hooliganism'. The court's order provides interim protection against coercive action. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Speeding Car Collides with Multiple Vehicles in Ludhiana
item.description: A speeding car collided with five other vehicles in Ludhiana, Punjab. A motorcyclist was thrown approximately 15 to 30 feet into the air following the impact. The incident was captured on CCTV, showing a frightening scene. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Karnataka forms SIT to reinvestigate Sowjanya rape and murder case
item.description: The Karnataka government has formed a Special Investigation Team (SIT) to reinvestigate the rape and murder case of Sowjanya. The case involves concerns about delays in reporting rape cases and low conviction rates in the state, with… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: An Air India pilot was suspended after failing a pre-flight breathalyzer test for alcohol in Zurich before a flight to Delhi on September 6. The pilot was removed from duty. This incident follows a previous report of a pilot failing a test… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 5 · Right 2.

item.description: Multiple videos have surfaced online showing alleged incidents of harassment and assault in Bihar. One video from Samastipur district's Musrigharari police station area shows a young man and woman on a scooter being stopped and subjected… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 3.

item.title: Volkswagen recalls 2.86 million vehicles globally for steering issue
item.description: Volkswagen is recalling approximately 2.86 million vehicles worldwide due to a potential steering failure risk. The recall affects VW brand vehicles and Audi models manufactured between 2013 and 2024. A company spokesman stated the recall… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.title: Teacher and Student Die During Iowa Field Trip
item.description: A fifth-grade teacher and a 10-year-old student died during a school field trip at Lake MacBride State Park in Iowa. The incident occurred on a field trip for fifth-grade students. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Supreme Court allows US voter database use for citizenship checks
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court has lifted restrictions on a federal database of voters, allowing the Trump administration to use it to check the citizenship of voters. The administration claimed the database, known as SAVE, would combat voting by… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.title: Ethiopia's Tigray Region Faces Internet, Phone Disruptions Amid Renewed Fighting
item.description: Internet and phone networks have been disrupted in Ethiopia's war-hit Tigray region following renewed fighting. The civil war in Tigray had previously led to the region being completely cut off from the outside world. Ethiopia's military… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 5 · Right 1.

item.title: Watchdog Urges Met Police to Investigate Itself Over Suspect's Arrest
item.description: A police watchdog has recommended that the Metropolitan Police investigate itself concerning the arrest of a suspect identified as the 'Putney pusher'. The watchdog's statement indicates a call for internal review of the arrest procedures. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Priest killed, four injured in knife attack at Polish abbey
item.description: A priest was killed and four other people were injured in a knife attack at an abbey in Jarosław, Poland. A male suspect from Ukraine was arrested following the incident, according to police. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 6 · Right 0.
